name: Ristorante Pizzeria da Pietro
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant Pizzeria da Pietro in Schwangau** – A cozy Italian eatery nestled in the heart of **Schwangau**, just steps away from **Neuschwanstein Castle**. Indulge in authentic **pizza**, fresh pasta, and hearty Italian dishes, all crafted with passion. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Lasagne**, this charming spot delivers delicious flavors in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Perfect for a quick lunch or a relaxed dinner after exploring the fairy-tale landscapes of **Tirol**. Don’t miss their homemade desserts—pure comfort in every bite! 🍕✨
